subject: Taking Time Retreats and Women's Wellness
overview: Medford Bytes hosted Jennifer Miller to discuss the launch of her 'Taking Time on the Cape' summer retreats and a new bimonthly meetup group for local women called Wicked Mindful Women.

items.title: Guest Introduction
items.summary: Guest Jennifer Miller introduced her background as a mental health counselor and drama teacher and shared her preference for Bocelli’s as a local eatery.

items.title: Taking Time Retreats
items.summary: Miller described 'Taking Time on the Cape,' an inaugural summer camp for women and caregivers featuring somatic healing, art, and connection sessions in August.

items.title: Wicked Mindful Women Meetups
items.summary: The guest announced the launch of a bimonthly meetup series at Deep Cuts designed to provide women a space for healing and social action.

items.title: Resources and Community Resilience
items.summary: Miller provided contact information for her initiatives and emphasized the importance of maintaining community relationships to combat isolation during stressful times.
